hero.title: Amplifying Women's Voices for a Brighter Future
hero.desc: Just Women is a women-led media and storytelling initiative creating opportunities for Afghan women and girls through journalism, education, storytelling and digital media.
about.label: OUR PURPOSE
about.title: Stories matter when women tell them.
about.body: Just Women brings together journalism, education, storytelling and digital media to create space for Afghan women's voices. We believe women should shape the stories told about their lives and communities.
features.label: WHAT WE DO
features.title: A platform for voices and possibility
feat.media.label: 01 / VOICES
feat.media.title: Media & Stories
feat.media.copy: A space for thoughtful reporting and first-person perspectives that place women's voices at the center.
feat.edu.label: 02 / LEARNING
feat.edu.title: Education & Training
feat.edu.copy: Learning and creative skills can open new ways to participate in journalism, storytelling and digital media.

s1.title: The Stories We Carry Forward
s1.sum: An editorial theme about memory, intergenerational conversation and the importance of telling a story in one's own words.
s2.title: Learning to Ask Better Questions
s2.sum: A look at listening, preparation and care as essential parts of responsible interviewing and reporting.
s3.title: Finding a Voice on Air
s3.sum: An editorial introduction to the possibilities of audio storytelling, from conversation to carefully produced narrative.
s4.title: A Place to Keep Learning
s4.sum: A reflection on curiosity, shared knowledge and the value of making room for girls' continued learning.
s5.title: Behind the Camera, Ahead of the Story
s5.sum: A short exploration of how visual skills and creative control can help storytellers shape their own narratives.
